title:

question:
Which top 4 leagues had the most games in the 2015-2016 season?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: in the 2015-2016 season refers to season = '2015/2016'; league with most games refers to League.name where MAX(COUNT(id))

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
    L.XCL_005
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_007
WHERE M.XCL_009 LIKE '2015-2016%'
GROUP BY L.XCL_003, L.XCL_005
ORDER BY COUNT(M.XCL_006) DESC
LIMIT 4
